exactUpstreamStatus.detail: Unmodified upstream 3.3.0 (C1) crashes cs2.exe during listen-server startup on CS2 1.41.8.5, the build it was probed on: managed NativeException 'Global Variables not initialized yet' from Utilities.GetPlayers() reached via Load() -> OnFileChanged(); process dies in coreclr.dll (0x80131623). Exact-upstream 3.3.0 is NOT accepted. This observation has not been re-run on the newer testedCs2Build, which only ever saw the patched runtime.

acceptedRuntime.definition: upstream commit fade4449aaa6d5153261c855d0cc12d7dacfefdd + experiments/cosmetics-lab/inventory-simulator/c1_1-startup-lifecycle-patch/c1_1-startup-lifecycle.patch (single line: Load() uses Inventories.Load(file) instead of OnFileChanged(null, file); OnFileChanged itself unchanged)
